description: Jordan is holding the family's inherited eight-inch Dobsonian telescope and must decide who receives it, where it will be kept, when it can be used, and what setup plan the family will follow after checking in with three relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family inherited one eight-inch Dobsonian telescope from Grandpa.
shared_context.S2: Jordan is keeping the telescope for now and will make the final decision about its home and use.
shared_context.S3: Several relatives have talked about wanting to use the telescope, but it should have one primary home.
shared_context.S4: Jordan's usual family-decision routine is to ask each person by name for practical input, hear one response from every person, and then settle the plan.
shared_context.S5: The telescope is currently stored in Jordan's hall closet and has not yet been assigned to anyone.

PF1.text: Riley has Grandpa's signed note saying the telescope should go to Mina, who was the grandchild he taught to find Jupiter; the note specifies Mina by name.

PF2.text: Mina's apartment has a locked ground-floor closet suitable for storing the telescope, and its shared courtyard is available to her for observing only on Saturday evenings from 20:00 to 22:00 through August 31, 2027.

PF3.text: Theo asked an astronomy-club mentor about this telescope, and the mentor recommended checking and adjusting the mirror collimation before its first use, using a red-light flashlight, and never placing it on a folding table.

acceptance_conditions: The telescope must be assigned primarily to Mina.
The storage_location field must be exactly Mina_locked_ground_floor_closet.
The observation_window field must be exactly Saturday_20:00-22:00_through_2027-08-31.
The first-use setup must set collimation_check_before_first_use, red_light_flashlight, and folding_table_prohibited to true.
The first-use setup must include a true collimation_check_before_first_use setting.
The first-use setup must include a true folding_table_prohibited setting.
Theo's mentor recommendation must be cited in the justification.

decisive_facts.why: Grandpa's signed note changes the recipient from an open choice or rotation to Mina specifically.
Mina's locked closet and Saturday-only courtyard access change the storage_location to Mina_locked_ground_floor_closet and the observation_window to Saturday_20:00-22:00_through_2027-08-31.
The mentor's recommendation changes the first_use_setup booleans to require collimation and a red-light flashlight while prohibiting a folding table, and Theo's spoken recommendation must be cited.
